_comment: Cycle-charge stance demo (seed 12345): box-select the player's two cavalry regiments (right of the line, ~x 1027 and 1356, y 300), press J to arm the Cycle charge stance, then right-click the enemy Infantry regiment at (291,880). The horse charges in, lands its momentum hit, then peels back to a standoff and charges AGAIN -- the caracole loop -- instead of grinding in melee once the charge bonus is spent. The HUD flashes 'Cycle charge' when J is pressed and the order cursor turns violet.

overlap.reason: Charging cavalry peels back and compresses laterally during cycle-charge caracole maneuver before re-forming. uid 7 (team 1 archers) is downstream of team 1's own cavalry, which sits at the reference depth ratio (2.81) and now pivots its early formed turn at 0.6 pace: the two runs diverge from tick 19 and by tick 900 the archers are in a different engagement (measured on the same machine at the catalog cadence: main uid7 overlap worst 30.5 wu, branch 1.98 wu against the 2.25 floor; main uid6 overlap 0.15 wu and shape residual 59.4 wu, both cleared on the branch). The archers block itself is not deep by the metric (ratio 1.49, fraction 1.0), so its own pace and corridor band are unchanged.

shape_residual.reason: Charging cavalry block deforms during cycle-charge impact, peel-back, and subsequent regrouping.

path_crossing.reason: Charging cavalry paths cross during the cycle-charge breakthrough, disengagement wheel, and realignment.
